subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medlytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: next step (technical deep dive)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation today — really helpful to understand Medlytics' use case for near-real-time inference across a mix of batch jobs and streaming inference. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary workload = patient-risk scoring (latency target 150ms avg p95), ~500 concurrent requests per region, models are currently PyTorch fine-tuned LLMs served on-prem.
- Risk/reqs you flagged: VPC/private deployment, KMS integration, audit logs retention, and SLA/uptime.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams so we can:
1) review current infra and deployment constraints
2) walk through model architecture, token lengths, and KV cache behavior
3) performance targets and load patterns (latency/throughput)
4) integration points (APIs, auth, data flows)
5) open questions on security/compliance needs

Proposed time windows (PT):
- Wed Oct 20, 10:00–11:30
- Thu Oct 21, 13:00–14:30
- Fri Oct 22, 09:00–10:30

Can you confirm which of these works and who from your team will join? I’ve attached the post-discovery notes and a short intake spreadsheet to capture environment details (post_discovery_notes.pdf, medlytics_requirements.xlsx).

If those windows don’t work, share a couple of alternatives and we’ll align. Once we lock a time I’ll send a calendar invite and an agenda doc.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

--
Attachments: post_discovery_notes.pdf, medlytics_requirements.xlsx

Appreciate the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. Wed Oct 20 10:00–11:30 PT looks good on our side. I’ll loop in our ML lead, Daniel Park (cc’d), and Olivia Reyes from infra; they’ll both join the deep dive.

A couple quick asks before the call:
- Can you include an agenda so our team can prep?
- Any pre-read about network requirements / KMS integration we should review?

If you can send a calendar invite for Wed we’ll accept.

Perfect — thanks Samir. I’ve added Dylan Brooks (platform lead) and Camila Reyes (solutions engineer) from our side; they’ll drive the deep-dive demo and infra discussion.

Confirmed: Wed Oct 20, 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min). Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

Attached is the proposed agenda (technical_deep_dive_agenda.docx) and a short pre-read on KMS/network requirements (post_discovery_notes.pdf). Items we’ll cover:
- Introductions & roles (5 min)
- Current infra & deployment constraints (15 min)
- Model architecture, token lengths, sequence distributions (15 min)
- Performance targets, load patterns, and benchmarking plan (20 min)
- Integration patterns: API, auth, fallback policies, and rollout strategy (15 min)
- Security/compliance: KMS, audit logs, data retention, SOC2 evidence (10 min)
- Next steps & mutual action plan (10 min)

Prep asks for Medlytics team: please bring a short diagram of your inference pipeline, expected qps and p95 targets by endpoint, and any network/VPC constraints. If you can populate the medlytics_requirements.xlsx with environment details before the call that would be great.

We’ll send the calendar invite & video link in a follow-up. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
